intro.hook: Tired of chore wars? With Check Mate, your only drama is on the TV.
intro.description: Stop passive-aggressive notes with active, shared tasks. Discover the new way of organising your house chores.

benefits.create: Create tasks in a snap. Assign chores to your housemates and share the load with a single tap.
benefits.dashboard: See your house at a glance. Your smart dashboard shows who's doing what, what's up next, and when it's done.
benefits.gamify: Make chores a game, not a war. Complete missions, earn badges, and turn cleaning into a friendly competition.
benefits.supplies: Never run out of soap again. Track shared supplies and add essentials like trash bags or sponges to a central shopping list.
